data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘homeros’, meaning ‘man of the earth’, ‘earth-born’. In Greek mythology, Omero was the legendary poet who sang the epic poems ‘Iliad’ and ‘Odyssey’. The name Omero carries the meaning “Man of the earth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Omero usually hope their child will grow to embody man of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
